requirements.name: Phased-array / beamforming signal processing

lines.quote: My background is in infrared and thermal imaging, not the specific signal processing domain your posting describes.

requirements.note: Candidate explicitly distinguishes her background from the posting's signal processing domain; no phased-array or beamforming work is described anywhere in the text.

requirements.name: RF measurement experience

lines.quote: Built automated test sequences for sensor validation, covering dynamic range, sensitivity, and noise equivalent temperature difference (NETD) measurements.

requirements.note: This describes infrared/thermal sensor validation measurements, not RF test-bench work (network analysers, spectrum analysers, RF front-end calibration); treated conservatively as not_stated rather than inferred as equivalent to RF measurement experience, per the refuse-to-guess rule.

requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent

lines.quote: My degree is in industrial engineering, which I know is not the obvious match, but the fourteen years of practical sensor work have given me a solid grounding in signal chain thinking, even if my entry point was imaging rather than what you typically look for.

requirements.note: Degree field is industrial engineering, not electrical engineering, physics or applied mathematics; whether this counts as a closely adjacent field, or the described sensor work as demonstrated equivalent competence, is not resolved here.

lines.quote: Internal R&D programme developing a multi-spectral thermal imaging payload for fixed-wing aircraft.
